categories.summary: Flight Centre is still investigating the theft of customer details, including passports, from an outside booking system; who did it is not known. Switzerland's government says hackers used AI agents in five attacks, including on power and water utilities, and the FBI warns of an AI attack tool used by Chinese and North Korean hackers. The suspected China campaign touches Australia (partly blamed on China by governments). An 'AI agents in Australian government systems' item in the campaign is an old OpenAI research mishap from September, not part of it. Australian phones, banks and the grid are normal.

headline: Kuwait says an Iranian drone attack killed two Italian defence workers; the Gulf war keeps fuel supply tight, but oil prices fell and SA fuel is normal.
summary: Kuwait says an Iranian drone attack killed two Italian defence workers; Iran denies it. The Houthis keep firing missiles and drones at Saudi ports and a refinery, and Saudi Arabia says it shot most of them down; no oil export damage is confirmed. One outlet reports renewed US strikes on Iran, but our searches did not confirm it. Oil fell about 3% to US$92, Hills fire danger is only Moderate, and Australian phones, banks and power are normal.
